title: BAI to Host Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course provides advanced training for Indian coaches, directly impacting the quality of coaching available to Indian badminton players nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team event, crucial for state-level competition and identifying emerging Indian talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Changed for Junior World Championships Trials
indian_angle: This change directly affects the composition of India's potential junior women's doubles representation at a major international event.
summary: An important notification from BAI announced a change in the Women’s Doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's top junior talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, a significant continental event.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Final Selection Trials for Junior World Championships Announced
indian_angle: This announcement details the crucial final trials for Indian players aiming to represent the country at the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: BAI has released the player eligibility criteria and list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.
